project.title: Why Perfect Railroads Don't Work
project.source: claude: annotated from mine/railroads_v2/shot_notes.txt, web/story.js (scenes, TRANS, KICKS) and the Gemini v1 plan; camera views are designed summaries of the story.js flights

narration.text: He sawed gaps into a railroad every thirty-nine feet. See, two companies are racing to build a railroad across a canyon so deep you can't see the bottom. And whoever finishes first gets the whole country's business. He's the youngest engineer on the job. And when his boss sees a finger wide gap between every single rail, his face turns purple. You're wrecking my railroad. But he won't close a single one. The other one lays rails end to end, perfectly smooth, and finishes first. Their trains glide across the canyon without a sound, while his go clickety clack over every gap. The newspapers start calling it the Clickety Clack Line, and everyone switches to the quiet trains. Then summer comes, and something weird happens. His gaps start shrinking in May. You can fit a coin in them by July. Barely a sheet of paper, and his boss is thrilled. See, even your gaps know you were wrong. Meanwhile, on the perfect railroad, the rails started groaning in the afternoon sun, pushing against each other like they want out. On the hottest day anyone can remember. His gaps finally close. Rail touching rail. Halfway across the canyon, the perfect railroad kicks sideways like a snake, right as a train rolls onto it.

depth_layers.background: hazy mesas and the far canyon wall

narration.text: He sawed gaps into a railroad every thirty-nine feet.

beats.visual_purpose: Show the odd act at once: a man sawing deliberate gaps into a steel rail.

camera.rationale: Start on the saw in the cut (SCR-03: hero object in frame, first flight inside 1 s), rise to show the man who does it.

narration.text: See, two companies are racing to build a railroad across a canyon so deep you can't see the bottom.

beats.visual_purpose: Show where and what is at stake: a very deep canyon with two bridges being built side by side.

camera.rationale: Rise and widen so the depth of the canyon is felt before the word "bottom".

narration.text: And whoever finishes first gets the whole country's business.

beats.visual_purpose: Meet the boss and the prize: whoever finishes first wins the country's business.

camera.rationale: A person states the stakes: hold and creep (CAM-13, CAM-08).

narration.text: He's the youngest engineer on the job.

beats.visual_purpose: Meet the young engineer in the canyon.

camera.rationale: A short slide in to meet his face; hat identifies him (CHR-02).

narration.text: And when his boss sees a finger wide gap between every single rail, his face turns purple.

beats.visual_purpose: The boss sees the gap and his face turns purple: a visual gag with an effect on the head.

character_actions.action: looks down at the gap, then stares

camera.rationale: Start on the gap, rise to the face, so the viewer sees cause and then reaction (CAM-04).

narration.text: You're wrecking my railroad.

beats.visual_purpose: The boss accuses the engineer: two people, one pointing.

camera.rationale: Small push on the accusation word; two-shot stays readable (CAM-08).

narration.text: But he won't close a single one.

beats.visual_purpose: The engineer refuses: arms crossed, stubborn face.

camera.rationale: Reaction beat is held (CAM-13); a slow creep keeps it alive.

narration.text: The other one lays rails end to end, perfectly smooth, and finishes first.

beats.visual_purpose: The other company lays smooth rails end to end: the camera runs along the perfect track.

camera.rationale: Fly down the unbroken rails so their length and smoothness show (CAM-07).

narration.text: Their trains glide across the canyon without a sound, while his go clickety clack over every gap.

beats.visual_purpose: Compare the two railroads: smooth silent train against the clickety-clack train.

camera.rationale: A high view shows both tracks and both trains at once (EXPLAIN_SYSTEM recipe).

narration.text: The newspapers start calling it the Clickety Clack Line, and everyone switches to the quiet trains.

beats.visual_purpose: The boss reads the bad news in the paper: the Clickety Clack Line.

camera.rationale: Reaction beat: hold on the sad face; the headline is readable (PRP-01).

narration.text: Then summer comes, and something weird happens.

beats.visual_purpose: Summer comes: the same place under hot golden light.

camera.rationale: Rise to show sun, cliffs and heat: the season changes the light (LIT-03).

narration.text: His gaps start shrinking in May.

beats.visual_purpose: The gaps shrink as the rails warm: show it on the rail itself.

camera.rationale: Push to the gap as it narrows.

narration.text: You can fit a coin in them by July.

beats.visual_purpose: A coin fits into the gap: size of the gap in July.

character_actions.action: reaches a coin into the gap

camera.rationale: Hold on the coin in the gap: the object is the number (PRF-04).

narration.text: Barely a sheet of paper, and his boss is thrilled.

beats.visual_purpose: Even less: a sheet of paper barely fits, and the boss is happy.

character_actions.action: slides a sheet into the gap, grins

camera.rationale: Same object-number idea one step smaller; a grin tells the reaction.

narration.text: See, even your gaps know you were wrong.

beats.visual_purpose: The boss laughs at the engineer: even his gaps say he was wrong.

camera.rationale: Two-shot with a laugh and crossed arms; hold (CAM-08).

narration.text: Meanwhile, on the perfect railroad, the rails started groaning in the afternoon sun, pushing against each other like they want out.

beats.visual_purpose: The perfect rails heat up and push against each other: glow and groan.

camera.rationale: A slow track along the joint where the pressure builds.

narration.text: On the hottest day anyone can remember.

beats.visual_purpose: The hottest day: heat shimmer over the long bridge.

camera.rationale: Move toward the bridge as the heat builds.

narration.text: His gaps finally close. Rail touching rail.

beats.visual_purpose: His gaps close: rail touches rail and nothing breaks.

camera.rationale: Hold where the two rail ends meet.

narration.text: Halfway across the canyon, the perfect railroad kicks sideways like a snake, right as a train rolls onto it.

beats.visual_purpose: The perfect track buckles sideways like a snake just as a train rolls on.

camera.rationale: Follow the train onto the track; two kicks on the buckle and the crash (FX-05).
